problems: Q148: republic-of-china and people-s-republic-of-china are different states (ROC continues on Taiwan to 2024); the ROC dossier keeps only the ROC row and the PRC is a successor of its mainland. The shared Wikidata id is Cliopatria's mistake.

Cliopatria's Kuomintang 1917-1929 shapes are country-wide outlines, not the KMT's land; kuomintang marks 1917-1924 wrong (Guangdong) and republic-of-china carries the Beiyang country as new keyframes 1916-1927; 1928-1929 is drawn by kuomintang only (republic-of-china has no keyframe for those years).

chinese-communists and communist-party-of-china share Q17427 and are one continuing party-state; kept as two dossiers because the second belongs to another batch of ea-08; the second should list chinese-communists as its predecessor.

empire-of-china is the same state as republic-of-china by the page's own words ('the Republic of China was restored'); give it the Republic's colour. Cliopatria gives all of 1916 to the Empire although it lasted to 22 March.
Cliopatria's Republic of China 1950-2023 shape is Taiwan plus Hainan plus Zhoushan (right for early 1950 only); new keyframe republic-of-china_1951 gives Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu.
Counterpart slugs manchukuo and mengjiang have no dossier yet (validator warnings in republic-of-china); the warlord cliques are used as counterpart names, not slugs.
qing-dynasty (ea-08-b), communist-party-of-china and people-s-republic-of-china (ea-08) did not exist yet; the matching loss/gain events must be checked once they are written.
Pages thin or wasted: Jinggangshan (disambiguation page), Ma Rulong (disambiguation page), Cen Yuying (not found). The Panthay and Chinese Communists budgets were spent without dating the main steps.
